name: hollow-eu-oct
comment: The middle rung of the k=2 cost ladder: hollow-eu-sq plus the octagon family {8} {8/3} {8/5} {8/7}. Carries GMS 1.6, 1.7, 1.8 and the convex 4.8.8 on top of what -sq already had. Its only job is to sit between the 4-tile and 14-tile palettes so the k=1 -> k=2 growth factor can be measured twice and not assumed once.
